Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular game sprite sheet in polished 3D figurine style. White minimalist consumer-electronics robot resembling a small smooth grain silo, subtle warm gray seams, brushed steel joints, black sensor slit. Front chest has a bold recognizable APPLE CORE silhouette: eaten sides, central narrow stem, bottom fruit remnants and one small leaf, dark gray, a satirical logo, no text.
Produce a 3-column by 2-row sheet, each isolated component on completely uniform #00ff00 green chroma-key, no shadows or gradients on background, no grid, no labels. Orthographic front/very slight three-quarter lighting from upper left, all parts fully contained with generous margins.
Top left: silo robot BODY ONLY with rounded white cylindrical shell, small circular base, apple-core logo, a visible circular shoulder socket at top center; no arm attached.
Top middle: upper arm link, straight horizontal pointing RIGHT, a white rectangular capsule with metallic circular hinge sockets at both ends, equal-size sockets, length about 3 times thickness.
Top right: forearm link, same straight horizontal orientation and sockets but slightly shorter and narrower.
Bottom left: open three-pronged robotic claw, wrist socket on LEFT and three curved gripper fingers reaching RIGHT, separated tips.
Bottom middle: same claw closed with fingers meeting, identical wrist registration and scale.
Bottom right: circular steel hinge cap viewed front-on, white outer rim and dark central axis.
These parts assemble into a robot with exactly three rotary articulation points: shoulder, elbow, wrist. Parts MUST be separate, no assembled robots or diagrams. White materials with readable dark mechanical outlines and tasteful pale cyan lights. No weapons.

Wide horizontal aspect 3.1:1, sign occupies the center 85 percent of image width with generous empty border. Polished 3D game prop style, crisp at 56 by 18 pixels. Uniform pure #00ff00 green chroma-key background, no cast shadow, no text other than EXIT, no arrows, no logos, no scene.
